# Your Team in India

> Your Team in India (YTII) is a premier offshore software development company providing AI-ready engineers, dedicated teams, and custom development services across web, mobile, cloud, and emerging technologies.

YTII specializes in offshore development with 14+ years of experience and 1000+ completed projects. The company offers flexible engagement models including dedicated teams, ODC, Virtual Captive Centers, and BOT outsourcing, serving Fortune 500 companies and startups globally with a focus on cost-effective, quality-driven solutions.
